name: LLM Prompt Injection
description: An adversary crafts input designed to override or manipulate an LLM application's intended instructions.

name: Extract LLM System Prompt
description: An adversary attempts to extract the hidden system prompt or configuration of an LLM-based application.

name: Craft Adversarial Data
description: An adversary crafts inputs specifically designed to cause a ML model to misclassify or behave unexpectedly.

name: Poison Training Data
description: An adversary manipulates training data to influence the behavior of a model trained on it.

name: LLM Plugin Compromise / Tool Abuse
description: An adversary manipulates an LLM agent into invoking tools/plugins outside their intended scope or permissions.

name: LLM Data Leakage
description: An LLM application exposes sensitive information it was trained on or has access to via its context/tools.
